overview.summary: This SQL setup script provisions a disposable CI database environment for the web-v2 office service. It creates three roles (anon, authenticated, service_role), an auth schema with a minimal users table, and a public table fajr_web_requests that stores incoming web request metadata (including service, destination, variant, contact, status, private_extra, and created_at). The script enables row level security on the fajr_web_requests table and revokes all privileges on it from public and the defined roles.
